verdict.rationale: Cursor's own docs describe Cloud Agents that run in isolated cloud VMs with full development environments. They can work in parallel for hours or days, keep running without the user's local machine connected, and can be launched from the desktop, web, Slack, GitHub, or the API, with SDK cloud runs that survive the caller disconnecting. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that long-running background cloud runs work as claimed.

support.subject: As a developer, I can delegate longer-running coding tasks to run in the background in an isolated cloud environment
